diagnostic_checks.look: Inspect the rooted base before selecting growth form

diagnostic_checks.look: Measure the spikelet and count lower glume veins

diagnostic_checks.look: Look for slender open non-golden flowering branches

diagnostic_checks.look: Measure the AWN and count its bends
diagnostic_checks.check: The fertile lemma has a usually 25–40 mm, twice-bent (bigeniculate) twisted awn; compare the actual fully extended awn on a mature attached floret.
diagnostic_checks.compare: S. nutans usually has a 10–22(30) mm once-bent awn; lengths overlap

diagnostic_checks.look: Confirm true membrane and empty pedicels
diagnostic_checks.check: The ligule is a ciliate membrane around 2–4 mm, not a pure hair fringe. Like other Sorghastrum, it has awned fertile sessile spikelets and companion barren pedicels where the paired spikelet would occur.
diagnostic_checks.compare: Sorghum has well-developed companion pedicelled spikelets
diagnostic_checks.certainty: Kew GrassBase-backed; separate collar and spikelet-pair photos required

field_rule: Identify endangered Texas wild-rice from legally permitted observation only: ribbon leaves streaming in running water, emerge a flowering axis, follow top ascending female-bearing and lower spreading male-bearing floral regions with dangling anthers. Final uncertain identifications belong to authorized botanical specialists. Do not touch/enter/collect protected plants.

head.reference: Flowering stalk holds lower hanging male flowers and upper erect female flowers; Hays County San Marcos River endemic. Do not touch or collect protected plants.

habit.reference: Rooted under running water, leaves stream parallel to current; stolons permit clonal spread. Do not require an exposed underground rhizome to match a field observation. Published GrassBase account calls it annual under some conditions; TPWD/USFWS emphasize perennial aquatic behavior.

awns.reference: Pistillate/female spikelets have slender awns 9–35 mm; male spikelets lack this feature, so observable awn state depends on sex and reproductive stage.
